name: Live witness
claim: I was pumping gas at the station on the north side of the highway and saw the car come over the hill and hit the truck.
assumptions: There is no gas station modeled on the north side of US-27A (only a retail/feed store on the SE corner at [18.2, 0, 19.6]). Taking the 'north side of the highway, facing the intersection' literally places the witness north of the westbound lanes (north edge at z = -35.1 m), at [0, 0, -45] m. Standing eye height of 1.6 m used for pumping gas. Observation time set to impact (~10.4 s after cresting at t=0), looking at Vehicle A.
